body:
Two more real, config-automation fixes: (1) console.html gained a real <a href> link to the provisioning URL that triggers the app's own VIEW/BROWSABLE intent-filter for one-tap, same-device setup, no scanning needed. (2) app.js now persists the provisioning URL (never the password) to localStorage after a successful register, and auto-re-registers from it on every app launch via tryAutoRegister() -- the phone now stays registered across restarts without adding any new plaintext-password storage. Commit 9539881.

⚓ ☃
title: SIP phone: one-tap same-device open + auto-register across restarts
